segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "JSON" when I talk about my computer project. I say "CSV" when I talk about my computer project. I say "log file" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use JSON, CSV, and log file. At the end, I say: I can use JSON clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“JSON、CSV 与日志”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。JSON：JSON 格式，用键和值表达结构化数据的文本格式。示例：I learned how to use "J son" in a computer task.CSV：逗号分隔值，用行列保存表格数据的文本格式。示例：I learned how to use "C S V" in a computer task.log file：日志文件，记录程序运行事件和错误的文件。示例：I learned how to use "log file" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“投诉、退换与解决问题”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。I'd like to return this.：我想退掉这个。。示例：I'd like to return this.This item is damaged.：这个商品损坏了。。示例：This item is damaged.I received the wrong order.：我收到了错误的订单。。示例：I received the wrong order.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

I tell my teammate: Today I use Could I get a refund?, Could you replace it?, and Thank you for resolving this.. At the end, I say: I can use Could I get a refund? clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“投诉、退换与解决问题”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。Could I get a refund?：我可以退款吗？。示例：Could I get a refund?Could you replace it?：你可以更换它吗？。示例：Could you replace it?Thank you for resolving this.：谢谢你解决这个问题。。示例：Thank you for resolving this.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“测试、构建与部署”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。test suite：测试套件，一组一起运行的测试。示例：Our team uses "test suite" to keep the project clear.build job：构建任务，把源代码转换成可运行产物的任务。示例：Our team uses "build job" to keep the project clear.deployment job：部署任务，把构建产物发布到环境的任务。示例：Our team uses "deployment job" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
